metaTitle: Digital Marketing Agency in Chicago, IL | TDM
metaDescription: Digital marketing for Chicago businesses: SEO, paid ads, social media, websites and video, planned neighbourhood by neighbourhood and season by season.
lead: TDM (The Digital Marketing Services) is a digital marketing agency that works remotely with Chicago businesses on SEO, paid advertising, social media, websites and video. Chicago is a city of neighbourhoods with a downtown full of corporate buyers, and it changes character between a hard winter and a short, packed summer. We build campaigns around the part of the city you serve and the time of year your customers spend.

sections.heading: A city people navigate by neighbourhood
paragraphs: Chicagoans identify with their neighbourhood first. Someone in Logan Square looks for a vet in Logan Square, not in Chicago. Lincoln Park and Lakeview on the North Side, Wicker Park and the West Loop to the west, Pilsen, Bridgeport and Hyde Park to the south each have their own shops, restaurants and loyalties, and the L line a person lives on shapes where they are willing to go.

The suburbs work the same way on a larger scale. Evanston and Oak Park border the city and behave like extensions of it, while Naperville, Schaumburg and the North Shore towns are destinations with their own business districts. A page that only says Chicago will not win searches in any of them.
bullets: Service pages named for the neighbourhoods and suburbs you actually cover.
Ad targeting drawn around realistic travel, by train or by car.
A complete, active Google Business Profile for each location.
A routine for asking customers for reviews, since map results depend on them.

sections.heading: The Loop, the West Loop and business buyers
paragraphs: Downtown Chicago is one of the country's main centres for finance and trading, built around its futures and options exchanges, along with law firms, consultancies, insurers and corporate headquarters. The West Loop and Fulton Market, once meatpacking streets, now hold technology offices and some of the city's best-known restaurants. River North is dense with agencies, showrooms and hotels.

Chicago is also a freight city. Railroads meet here, O'Hare moves a great deal of cargo, and food manufacturers and distributors have been part of the economy for generations. Companies that sell to these buyers need marketing that suits a slow, careful purchase: pages that explain exactly what you do, search visibility for the specific terms a buyer types, and LinkedIn campaigns aimed at the right roles.
McCormick Place hosts large trade shows through the year. If your customers attend one, the weeks around it are the time to run targeted ads and publish show-specific pages.

sections.heading: Winter, summer and the event calendar
paragraphs: Chicago winters are long and cold. Demand rises for heating repair, plumbing, snow clearing and delivery, and falls for anything that needs a patio. Much of the housing is older brick bungalows, two-flats and greystones, so boilers, masonry, roofs and basements keep the trades busy.

Summer is the opposite. The lakefront, street festivals, rooftop bars and events such as Lollapalooza in Grant Park bring residents and visitors outdoors, and restaurants, venues and retailers make a large part of their year in a few months. The marathon in autumn and holiday shopping on Michigan Avenue add their own peaks. We set budgets and content by month instead of spreading them evenly.

items.title: Restaurants and bars
items.text: A serious food city with strong neighbourhood loyalty. Listings, photography, short video and reservations that work on a phone.

items.title: Professional services
items.text: Law, accounting and consulting firms in the Loop need a clear page for each practice area and search visibility for precise problems.

items.title: Home services and trades
items.text: Heating, plumbing, masonry and roofing firms working on older buildings win through map results and neighbourhood pages.

items.title: Logistics and food distribution
items.text: Carriers, warehouses and food suppliers need sites that set out services, coverage and certifications plainly.

items.title: Healthcare and wellness
items.text: Clinics, dentists and therapists compete block by block. Reviews, practitioner pages and compliant ad wording matter.

items.title: Retail and e-commerce
items.text: Shops with a local following can sell nationally with a store that converts, product photography and ads managed against margin.

faqs.a: No. We work with Chicago businesses remotely, through video calls, shared documents and regular reports.

faqs.q: How do I rank in Google Maps for my Chicago neighbourhood?
faqs.a: Complete your Google Business Profile with accurate categories, hours and photos, keep your name and address identical everywhere online, collect real reviews steadily, and have a page on your site about the neighbourhood you serve. Distance from the searcher matters, so expect to rank best close to your address.

faqs.q: What does digital marketing cost for a Chicago business?
faqs.a: It depends on the scope of work, the channels and how contested your field is. We give a quote after a free consultation about your goals.

faqs.q: Should I target the city and the suburbs in one campaign?
faqs.a: No. Costs, competitors and search terms differ. Separate campaigns let you see which areas pay back and move budget accordingly.

faqs.q: When should a Chicago restaurant or venue advertise most?
faqs.a: Usually ahead of patio and festival season and again before the holidays, but your own sales history is the better guide. We plan the calendar from your figures and adjust as results come in.
